title: Calphurnius Piso
summary: Raleigh names Calphurnius Piso in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Calphurnius Piso, named with Q. Fabius Pictor and Portius Cato among those who deriue the Romans from Ianus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. V, sig. 349a
